summary: Camtek Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, comprising an analyst and investor presentation deck for October 2026. The filing describes the company as a high-end inspection and metrology systems provider for semiconductor manufacturing, citing a revenue CAGR from 2019 to 2025, cash, deposits and cash equivalents, 2026 estimated revenues, employees, and a customer base that includes all top 20 semiconductor manufacturers with roughly 4,000 installed systems. The 6-K was signed by Chief Financial Officer Moshe Eisenberg and incorporates the presentation by reference into effective registration statements. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed. Watch for any subsequent 6-K disclosing an actual strategic transaction.
